system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Simon Peter, bare-chested in a short work tunic, pulling a linen mantle around himself as he leaps from the boat","action":"Peter springs over the gunwale and plunges into the shallow water toward the shore, while the disciple John points toward the figure on the beach","setting":"Shore of the Sea of Galilee at Tiberias, wooden fishing boat with nets on still water, charcoal fire glowing on the beach","secondaryElements":"Jesus standing near the fire on the sand, other disciples in the boat hauling in heavy nets, drifting mist lifting off the lake, scattered fish in the nets","mood":"Urgent joy and sudden reverent devotion, tender and hopeful","timeOfDay":"Daybreak, pale dawn light warming toward golden sunrise over the water","composition":"Wide shot from the lake, boat diagonal in the foreground, Peter mid-leap at the center, fire and Jesus small on the distant shore"}
